identity_controls.description: Offer a legal option set from a superseded decision point and require fail-closed rejection.
Submit an option that is not a member of the current engine-authorized set; require rejection with no state change.
Submit a legal option from a non-owning principal; require rejection.
Submit the right option under the wrong decision kind (e.g. a target where a mode is required); require rejection.
Submit a decision with no native binding (no engine object/ability/choice identity behind it); require fail-closed, never silent accept.
Where structurally representable, submit an ambiguous multi-binding and require disambiguation or rejection, never silent first-match.
Submit the scripted decisions in a swapped order; require rejection or re-offer, never silent reordering.

hidden_information_controls.description: Plant a synthetic opponent-hand identity in a non-owner observation probe and require the harness to flag the leak (detector calibration, not behavior).
Require a planted library-identity leak to be flagged in any non-searcher projection.
Require a planted face-down identity leak to be flagged in any observer projection.
Require a planted opponent-hand leak to be flagged for every scenario carrying NC-HIDDEN-HAND-LEAK.

note: All controls are SYNTHETIC_NEGATIVE_CONTROL: they test the future qualification harness, never Magic card behavior, and never count as actual-card coverage. Scenario files reference applicable control IDs in their negative_controls fields.

qualification_controls.description: Execute a scenario against a deliberately wrong expected Rules outcome and require the harness to report FAIL (verdict-calibration).

replay_controls.description: Re-execute with one scripted decision changed and require DIVERGED (not silent PASS).
Re-execute with changed RNG outcome/seed input and require DIVERGED with journal mismatch flagged.
Re-execute with one scripted decision omitted and require fail-closed or DIVERGED, never silent PASS.
